method: Identical finite nonce set, message, difficulty and worker count; fixed full work; alternating order; same warmed process pool; independent proof validation outside timing
assumption: If distinct SHA-256 inputs behave like independent uniform 256-bit outputs, each unique nonce has success probability 16^(-difficulty). Expected attempts are 16^difficulty and expected seconds are approximately 16^difficulty / aggregate_unique_hashes_per_second in an unbounded-trial approximation. A finite nonce window may contain no proof. Visiting a different region gives no guaranteed advantage.
